Environmental Protection Agency (EPA). EPA stated that the discussion on market shifts should be broadened to include potential shifts to or from foreign production if these shifts are significant.
Summary. FEA recommended the consideration of shifts to passenger automobiles from NPA's. GM and Ford stated that they agreed that setting an AFES too high will produce the negative effect of the market shift discussed in the NPRM and the draft EIS. They further state that it is the consumer that dictates market shifts. AMC stated that they do not see any market shifts for their vehicles resulting from the AFES. EPA recommended adding a discussion of any potential market shifts to or from foreign production.
